carpet.rule.noAttackCooldown.name: No Attack Cooldown
carpet.rule.noAttackCooldown.desc: Completely removes the attack cooldown: every hit counts as a full-charge hit (full damage, crits, sweep, knockback). While enabled, armor stands also take no damage from players.
carpet.rule.noAttackSpeedLimit.name: No Attack Speed Limit
carpet.rule.noAttackSpeedLimit.desc: Removes the 10 tick hurt immunity window from player damage, so every attack deals damage - several attacks within the same game tick all count. Combined with noAttackCooldown this makes attack speed truly unbounded.
carpet.rule.customNetherPortal.name: Custom Nether Portal
carpet.rule.customNetherPortal.desc: Any closed obsidian loop inside a vertical plane can be lit as a nether portal, not just vanilla rectangles. The enclosed area may have any shape but must stay within 1..21 blocks in both directions.
carpet.rule.horizontalNetherPortal.name: Horizontal Nether Portal
carpet.rule.horizontalNetherPortal.desc: Allows a closed obsidian loop lying flat on the ground to be lit as a horizontal portal whose blocks face up/down (towards the ground). Works on its own and together with Custom Nether Portal.
carpet.rule.netherPortalSearchRadius.des: Radius used to search for an existing portal on the overworld side (vanilla hardcodes 128). Bigger values link to far away portals instead of creating a new one; range 16..512, larger values load more chunks.
carpet.rule.higherEnchantmentLevels.name: Higher Enchantment Levels
carpet.rule.higherEnchantmentLevels.desc: Anvil merging can exceed the vanilla cap up to level 10. Enchanting tables and loot still only roll vanilla levels, so 6..10 is anvil-only.
carpet.rule.noAnvilPenalty.name: No Anvil Penalty
carpet.rule.noAnvilPenalty.desc: Survival anvils never show "Too Expensive": operations above 40 levels still work, and the compounding prior-work penalty is removed.
carpet.rule.villagerFastDiscount.name: Villager Fast Discount
carpet.rule.villagerFastDiscount.desc: One cure of that villager, or having Hero of the Village, pushes every trade down to the lowest possible price (1 item) - no repeated curing needed.
carpet.rule.villagerSafeDiscount.name: Villager Safe Discount
carpet.rule.villagerSafeDiscount.desc: Villagers always convert into zombie villagers when killed by a zombie, regardless of difficulty, so you can farm the cure discount without playing on hard.
carpet.rule.efficientIronFarm.name: Efficient Iron Farm
carpet.rule.efficientIronFarm.desc: Golem detection scans every 5 ticks instead of 200; the villager gossip cooldown drops from 1200 to 1 tick; and a single villager is enough to agree on spawning a golem (vanilla needs 5).
carpet.rule.whiteLooting.name: White Looting
carpet.rule.whiteLooting.desc: Makes Looting work on iron golems: +1 iron ingot per level, plus 0..level extra poppies (vanilla's golem loot table has no looting function at all).
carpet.rule.superFastFurnace.name: Super Fast Furnace
carpet.rule.superFastFurnace.desc: Every furnace, smoker and blast furnace recipe finishes in 1 tick (the recipe cooking time itself is overridden, so it applies to the first and every later smelt).
carpet.rule.fortuneClay.name: Fortune Clay
carpet.rule.fortuneClay.desc: Mining clay with a Fortune shovel always drops at least 4 + fortune level clay balls (5 with Fortune I) instead of the vanilla 4.
carpet.rule.halfSlabBreak.name: Better Slab Placement
carpet.rule.halfSlabBreak.desc: Breaking a double slab only destroys one half: the block stays as a single slab and drops one slab item (vanilla removes the whole block and drops two). Mining from above keeps the bottom half, from below keeps the top half.
carpet.rule.fastHopper.name: Fast Hopper
carpet.rule.fastHopper.desc: An Efficiency V enchanted book can be applied to a hopper in an anvil; hoppers with Efficiency V transfer one item per tick instead of one per 8 ticks.
carpet.rule.fastElytra.name: Fast Elytra
carpet.rule.fastElytra.desc: Firework rockets no longer pull elytra flight back to the 1.5 blocks/tick cap; each rocket tick adds speed along the look direction, stacking without limit.
carpet.rule.mixedSlab.name: Mixed Slabs
carpet.rule.mixedSlab.desc: Right-click a single slab with a different slab to combine both materials into one full block; breaking it splits off only the aimed half.
carpet.rule.simpleObserverPlacement.name: Simple Observer Placement
carpet.rule.simpleObserverPlacement.desc: Placing a block against an observer's face no longer makes it pulse; other block changes are still detected normally.
carpet.rule.silkTouchFortune.name: Silk Touch + Fortune
carpet.rule.silkTouchFortune.desc: Silk Touch and Fortune no longer conflict and can be put on one tool; mining ice, packed ice or blue ice with both multiplies the silk-touch drop by fortune level + 1.
carpet.rule.hopperIdleCooldown.name: Hopper Optimization
carpet.rule.hopperIdleCooldown.desc: Ticks an idle hopper waits after a failed transfer (0 = vanilla retries every tick; 4-8 recommended). The 54-slot container array cache is always on.
carpet.rule.noIceMelting.name: Ice? Water?
carpet.rule.noIceMelting.desc: Ice no longer melts from light; breaking it by hand still turns it into a water source (silk touch still drops ice).
